messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — support ticket #18742. Customer hitting intermittent 5xx + long tail timeouts from hosted inference. P95 ~ 8s, some 504s. They saw a big queue backlog spike around 16:02 UTC.
Priya (support): Customer report: 200k requests over 6m, tenant rate looked normal but their requests started getting 5xx and then timeouts. They captured curl repro and a few stack traces. Ticket attached.
Maya K: Looking at metrics for pool hosted-us-east-1-gp3 — request_queue_depth jumped from ~300 -> ~8200 in ~90s. Continuous-batcher backlog grew and dequeue rate dropped. I'm seeing batching threads waiting on kvcache evictions.
Samir P: Can you paste the gateway logs + the request headers? Also did auth/billing return OK for that tenant? Sometimes token retries amplify spikes.
Priya (support): Auth looks fine, billing ok. Gateway shows many 502/504 from the proxy layer. Snippet:
```
[16:02:17] gateway: enqueue request tenant=acme-corp id=xx... depth=4321
[16:02:18] runtime: batcher wait for kvcache eviction, hold=2.3s
[16:02:20] proxy: 502 upstream_timeout host=runtime-3
```
Nora SRE: That sequence looks like continuous-batcher threads are blocked on long sequence handling + aggressive kvcache evictions. When eviction stalls, batch formation stalls and queue builds up -> tail timeouts.
Alex W: Repro steps from support (small curl loop):
```
for i in {1..2000}; do \
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","prompt":"short","max_tokens":1024}' &
done
```
Samir P: Thanks. Quick mitigations we pushed: scaled up the batcher pool by +3 nodes, temporarily increased request_queue_size on that host group from 4k -> 12k, and enabled fallback routing to ded-1 for the tenant. That immediately dropped 5xx rate.
Maya K: After scale, dequeue rate back to normal and backlog drained over ~4m. P95 dropped from 8s -> 350ms. Logs show a few remaining long-seq requests that hit kvcache eviction boundary.
Priya (support): Customer confirmed improvement and dropped escalation. They asked for root cause and long-term fix.
Nora SRE: Root cause summary: sudden client burst with high max_tokens caused continuous-batcher threads to block on kvcache eviction under memory pressure. This reduced dequeue throughput and created a queue pile-up; proxy timed out waiting for runtime -> 5xx/504.
Alex W: Next actions:
- Add guardrail: per-tenant max_tokens and connection rate caps (support action item).
- Runtime: add a fast-path that rejects requests above X seq len instead of stalling (eng-runtime).
- Ops: revert temporary queue_size increase once we deploy fixes; add alert for queue_depth > 2k sustained for 30s.
- Add a runbook step: if queue_depth spike + batcher dequeue drop -> scale batchers and enable tenant fallback.
Samir P: File created for follow-ups: infra ticket INF-1291 to add eviction timeout + better kvcache backoff. Assigning to eng-runtime.
oncall-bot: Incident note saved to #incidents-log, severity=P2, start=5823456789, mitigated=5823456797.
Priya (support): Marking ticket resolved with customer. Will keep them updated on the runtime fixes timeline.
Alex W: Nice triage — closing thread but leaving INF-1291 open until runtime patch is deployed. :thumbsup:
